hierarchies.name: unseenet
hierarchies.title: The Unseenet project
hierarchies.description: The project's own groups: announcements, the node list, the root list, names, and talk about Unseenet.

hierarchies.name: alt
hierarchies.title: Anything goes
hierarchies.description: Anybody may create anything here, as on Usenet.

hierarchies.name: test
hierarchies.title: Testing
hierarchies.description: For trying things out. Nodes keep it only briefly.

hierarchies.name: docs
hierarchies.title: Documentation
hierarchies.description: Documentation as sites, such as the project's own in docs.unseenet.*: docs.unseenet.clients for the clients, later docs.unseenet.servers. Anybody may publish some.

hierarchies.name: demo
hierarchies.title: Demonstrations
hierarchies.description: Demos of what Unseenet can do, such as the demo village in demo.unseenet.*. Anybody may make one.

hierarchies.name: usenet
hierarchies.title: Usenet, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Groups gatewayed from Usenet (UN-RFC 0023, 0024), e.g. usenet.comp.misc. Governed once the first gateway is endorsed.

hierarchies.name: fido
hierarchies.title: FidoNet, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for echo areas gatewayed from FidoNet (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: matrix
hierarchies.title: Matrix, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for public rooms gatewayed from Matrix (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: irc
hierarchies.title: IRC, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to IRC channels (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: xmpp
hierarchies.title: XMPP, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to XMPP group chats (MUC) (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: fedi
hierarchies.title: The fediverse, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to fediverse communities and groups (ActivityPub: Lemmy, Mastodon and others) (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: nostr
hierarchies.title: Nostr, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to Nostr channels and groups (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: torproject
hierarchies.title: Held for the Tor Project
hierarchies.description: Kept for the Tor Project, so that nobody - the Unseenet project included - can look as if it speaks for it. Theirs to claim when they want it (UN-RFC 0018 section 7).

hierarchies.name: tor
hierarchies.title: Held for the Tor Project
hierarchies.description: Kept for the Tor Project, as torproject is. Groups about Tor live under alt.tor.

hierarchies.name: bsky
hierarchies.title: Bluesky, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to feeds and groups on Bluesky and the AT Protocol (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: discord
hierarchies.title: Discord, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to Discord channels (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: telegram
hierarchies.title: Telegram, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to Telegram groups and channels (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: slack
hierarchies.title: Slack, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to Slack channels (UN-RFC 0023).

hierarchies.name: reddit
hierarchies.title: Reddit, through gateways
hierarchies.description: Held for a possible gateway to subreddits (UN-RFC 0023).
